messages:
Jia: ok bringing up rwd-llm-13b-v2 (torch2 export) for a quick quant probe across AWQ-int4, gptq-int8, and fp8. baseline is fp32 hosted. want a small hosted canary + private canary.
Mike: nice. can you drop the eval harness and the golden chat set? i can run microbatch profiling.
Jia: uploaded harness at /evals/rwd-13b-v2/chat-goldenset.tar.gz. goal: surface top-3 QA deltas, rouge-l, and response-length regressions. keep canary to 1% then 10% if clean.
Sagar: regression thresholds: -1.5% absolute on top-1 QA or >3% failure rate on heuristics => auto-fallback. also flag length changes >20 tokens median.
Leah: add rollout policy: hosted route first, fallback to hosted-fp32 if regression, and route private customers to private-canary variants. can we codify as JSON?
Mike: config snippet: 
```json
{
  "route": "hosted-chat",
  "variants": ["rwd-13b-v2-fp32", "rwd-13b-v2-awq-int4", "rwd-13b-v2-gptq-int8", "rwd-13b-v2-fp8"],
  "traffic": {"fp32": 0.98, "probe": 0.02},
  "metrics": {"qa_threshold_pct": 1.5, "rollback_on_fail": true}
}
```
Mike: microbatch config i'll test: `microbatch_size=8` `max_latency_ms=120`
Omar: for private customers we should start at 0.5% and run longer probes. their latency SLO is stricter. plan to test on dedicated infra too.
Alexa: FYI cost estimates: AWQ-int4 ~0.35x tokens cost, gptq-int8 ~0.5x, fp8 ~0.6x vs fp32. latency improvements: int4/awq best for long context.
canary-bot: canary started for 2087654321: hosted probe 2% traffic -> variants: awq-int4,gptq-int8,fp8. rollout_id=rb-2087. :rocket:
eval-bot: preliminary results (1h): AWQ-int4: top1_delta=-0.8% , gptq-int8: top1_delta=-0.6%, fp8: top1_delta=-0.4%. median latency (tokens/s): fp32=100, awq=145, gptq=130, fp8=120.
Jia: good — deltas within threshold for now but need sample-level analysis. can we get the failure list?
Sagar: pulled failures into /evals/rb-2087/failures.csv and added tags: hallucination, truncation, formatting. most hallucinations on math Q/A sequences.
Leah: action items: 1) run reranker/regression on top 500 queries 2) run longer private probe (24h) 3) prepare rollback playbook and alerting (slo breach + regression).
Mike: running reranker pass now, will push results in ~45m.
Omar: if reranker reduces hallucinations for awq, we can promote awq to 10% hosted and 2% private. else fallback to fp32 for affected routes.
Alexa: also check KV-cache correctness in torch2 export — saw a weird tokenization edge in a local run. add tokenization testcases.
Jia: noted. tagging @mike @sagar for follow-ups. thanks all. :thumbsup:
